overview.title: Welcome to CIVINEX
overview.description: Explore government welfare schemes and access their supporting documents in one place.
overview.schemesDescription: Search available schemes and review their descriptions, benefits, eligibility rules, and official sources.
overview.documentsDescription: View scheme documents and access supporting information. Document uploads are restricted to administrators.
overview.assistantDescription: Ask questions about government welfare schemes, understand eligibility requirements, and get guidance using available scheme information.
overview.aboutDescription: Civinex is a welfare-scheme assistance project designed to help people discover relevant government schemes and understand their published information. Always verify eligibility and application requirements through the relevant official government source.
overview.disclaimer: Civinex is an independent project and is not an official government website.

schemesPage.title: Government schemes
schemesPage.description: Search and explore scheme information published in the Civinex database.
schemesPage.searchPlaceholder: Search by scheme name, code, or description
schemesPage.noSchemesDescription: No schemes match your current search and filters. Try changing your search or clearing the filters. If no schemes have been added to the database yet, results will appear after records are created.
schemesPage.unableToLoad: An unexpected error occurred while loading schemes.

documentsPage.title: Scheme documents
documentsPage.description: View scheme document records and their processing status.
documentsPage.viewPermission: You can view document records. Only administrators can upload documents.
documentsPage.noDocumentsDescription: No document records have been added yet. Administrators can upload a document to create the first record.
documentsPage.unableToLoad: An unexpected error occurred while loading documents.

assistantPage.title: CIVINEX AI Assistant
assistantPage.description: Ask questions about welfare schemes and receive answers based on indexed scheme documents.
assistantPage.introDescription: Ask about scheme benefits, eligibility requirements, application procedures, or supporting documents.
assistantPage.questionPlaceholder: Example: What documents are required for this scheme?
assistantPage.preparingDescription: JanSahay is searching indexed documents and generating a response. The first request may take longer while the local language model loads.
assistantPage.groundingWarning: This response could not be grounded in retrieved source passages. Verify the information with the relevant official government source before relying on it.
assistantPage.sourcesDescription: Check these scheme documents and official links to verify the answer.
assistantPage.noSourcesDescription: No source documents were returned for this answer. Try another question or check whether documents have been indexed.
assistantPage.disclaimer: AI-generated answers may be incomplete or incorrect. Scheme rules can change. Verify eligibility, benefits, deadlines, and application requirements using the official government source. JanSahay is a prototype and is not an official government service.
assistantPage.noOfficialLink: Official website link is not available.
assistantPage.invalidSourceLink: The supplied source link is invalid.
assistantPage.questionTooShort: Please enter a question containing at least 3 characters.
assistantPage.unableToGenerate: Unable to generate an answer. Please try again.
assistantPage.matchedSchemesDescription: These schemes matched your question based on information stored in CIVINEX. Verify their details with the official source.

eligibilityPage.title: Eligibility Checker
eligibilityPage.description: Compare your details against the selected scheme's configured eligibility rules.
eligibilityPage.notice: Provide only the details needed for this check. This prototype does not save your profile through this endpoint. Results are preliminary and are not official government decisions.
eligibilityPage.detailsDescription: Leave unknown details blank. JanSahay will identify missing information when possible.
eligibilityPage.noSchemes: No active schemes are available. Add a scheme before checking eligibility.
eligibilityPage.invalidAge: Enter a whole number for age between 0 and 120.
eligibilityPage.invalidIncome: Enter a valid, non-negative annual income.
eligibilityPage.unableToCheck: Unable to check eligibility. Please try again.

documentUpload.title: Upload a scheme document
documentUpload.description: Add an official PDF and associate it with a scheme in the database.
documentUpload.invalidPdfType: The selected file must have a PDF content type.
documentUpload.fileTooLarge: The PDF must be 10 MB or smaller.
documentUpload.choosePdfError: Choose a PDF file to upload.
documentUpload.uploadFailed: The document could not be uploaded.
documentUpload.addSchemeFirst: Add an active scheme to the database before uploading its documents.
documentUpload.titleHelp: Optional. Defaults to the filename if left blank.
documentUpload.choosePdf: Choose a PDF from your computer
documentUpload.pdfLimit: PDF only · Maximum file size 10 MB
documentUpload.footerNote: Uploaded documents are stored on the backend. Only document metadata is displayed in the records table.

backendStatus.title: Backend connectivity
backendStatus.healthCheckFailed: Backend health check did not return OK.
backendStatus.connectionFailed: Unable to connect to the backend.

recommendationsPage.title: Scheme Recommendations
recommendationsPage.description: Assess active schemes against the details you provide. Your profile is used for these checks and is not saved by this page.
recommendationsPage.notice: These are preliminary assessments based on configured rules, not official government decisions. Incomplete or unverified scheme rules may affect the results.
recommendationsPage.profileDescription: Enter any details you know. Missing details may limit the results.
recommendationsPage.noActiveSchemes: No active schemes are available yet. Add schemes first.
recommendationsPage.enterProfileDetail: Enter at least one profile detail to assess schemes.
recommendationsPage.noSchemesToAssess: There are no active schemes to assess.
recommendationsPage.noAssessmentsCompleted: No assessments could be completed. Check the backend and scheme rules.
recommendationsPage.disclaimer: Civinex is an independent prototype, not an official government service. Confirm scheme conditions with the relevant government department before applying.

myApplications.title: My Applications
myApplications.description: Manage saved welfare schemes and track application records.
myApplications.notesPlaceholder: Optional notes for your own reference
myApplications.noSavedSchemesDescription: Save schemes from Find Schemes to access them here.
myApplications.noRecordsDescription: Add a tracking record to keep your own reference details in one place.
myApplications.personalRecordNotice: Personal CIVINEX record only; verify actual application status with the relevant authority.
myApplications.disclaimer: CIVINEX does not submit applications to government departments or independently verify approval status.

header.notificationsLater: Notifications will be available in a later phase

helpPage.title: Help Centre
helpPage.description: Learn how to use CIVINEX to discover and understand government welfare schemes.
helpPage.welcomeDescription: Find guidance for the main features of the application. CIVINEX is an independent project, not an official government website.
helpPage.findingSchemesDescription: Search schemes by name, government level, state, or category. Open a scheme to review its benefits, eligibility, and available information.
helpPage.eligibilityCheckerDescription: Enter the requested details to review potential eligibility. Results are guidance, not a guarantee of approval.
helpPage.aiAssistantDescription: Ask questions about welfare schemes. Verify important requirements with the relevant official government source.
helpPage.myApplicationsDescription: Save schemes and maintain records of applications you are tracking. A CIVINEX record does not itself submit an official application.
helpPage.documentsDescription: Browse available scheme documents and review their processing status.
helpPage.officialInfoDescription: Check the relevant government department or official scheme portal for application deadlines, required documents, submission confirmation, and final status.

authPage.loginDescription: Sign in to access your CIVINEX workspace.
authPage.registerDescription: Register to get started with your welfare assistance workspace.
authPage.passwordLengthError: Your password must contain at least 8 characters.
authPage.registrationSuccess: Registration successful. You can now log in.
authPage.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
authPage.disclaimer: CIVINEX is an independent project, not an official government website. Verify scheme information through official sources.

schemeForm.title: Add Government Scheme
schemeForm.description: Enter verified scheme information from an official government source.
schemeForm.schemeNamePlaceholder: e.g. Scheme name from official guidelines
schemeForm.schemeCodeHint: Leave empty if no reliable code is available.
schemeForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the scheme using verified official information.
schemeForm.benefitsPlaceholder: Explain the benefits and any relevant conditions.
schemeForm.jsonDisclaimer: These rules are structured data, not automatically verified eligibility criteria.
schemeForm.nameValidation: Enter a scheme name with at least 2 characters.
schemeForm.stateValidation: Enter the state for a state-level scheme.
schemeForm.jsonObjectValidation: Eligibility rules must be a JSON object, for example: {"minimum_age": 18}.
schemeForm.invalidJsonValidation: Eligibility rules contain invalid JSON. Check the brackets, quotes, and commas.
